text: その　ていどで　かった　きに　なんなよな

patterns.name: 〜きになる
patterns.span: かった　きに　なん
patterns.explanation: A past-form verb followed by きになる means 'to feel as if you have done it'; なん is なる slurred before な. かった　きに　なん = 'feel like you've won'.

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after a plain verb is a blunt 'don't do it'. なんな is the slurred form of なるな = 'don't become'.
